datasets.title: Burundi: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Burundi: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/highresolutionpopulationdensitymaps-bdi]

lineage.description: Machine learning algorithms identified building footprints from commercial satellite imagery across Burundi. Population estimates derived from publicly available census data and demographic statistics were spatially allocated to building locations using Columbia University's methodology, generating seven high-resolution gridded population density maps for 2020 representing overall population and demographic subgroups.

sources.name: Facebook/Meta AI and Data for Good
sources.description: Machine learning-derived building footprints from satellite imagery used as the spatial framework for population distribution modeling

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Population estimation methodology overlaying census data and demographic statistics onto building-level spatial units to generate high-resolution population density maps
